senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שרר) [chain, string; cmp. חָרַז,] verse, song, poetry, music.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 5:6">Tam. V, 6</cite> <he>שאחיו … לדבר בש׳</he> that his brother Levites were assembling to sing in chorus.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 7:4">Ib. VII, 4</cite> <he>הש׳ שהיו הלוים וכ׳</he> these are the psalms that the Levites recited severally on each day; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:17">R. Hash. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>התוקע לש׳</he> he who blows the Shofar (on the New Year’s Day) as a musical exercise (Ms. M. <he>לשֵׁד</he> to drive off a demon); <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 33b">ib. 33ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>לשֵׁיד</he>).—<he>כלי ש׳</he> musical instruments (used in the Temple during the offering of sacrifices).
<cite ref="Taanit 4a">Taan. I</cite>V (III), 3; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="U01079"><he>שִׁירִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01080"><he>שִׁירִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>דוד אמר ש׳ ושלמה אמר ש׳</he> David composed songs, and so did Solomon.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Ib.</cite> end (expl. <he>שיר השירים</he>) <he>המעולה שבש׳</he>; <he>המסולסל שבש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O01011"><he>סִלְסֵל</he></cite>.

Ib. נאמר ש׳ ונשבח למי שעשאנו ש׳ בעולם let us recite songs and praise to him who has made us to be songs (proclaimers of God’s praise) in the world; נאמר ש׳ … שיורים לעולם let us recite songs to him who made us remnants (has preserved us) for the world; a. fr.—שיר הש׳ the Book of Song of Songs (Canticum).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:11">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
